rationale: Full declared backend/frontend enums and independent relaykit identity mappings reserve through 64. No declared channel 65 exists. Add plugin 65 and bounds-safe base URL lookup; do not rewrite existing channel types or interpret downstream 61 as upstream plugin 61.
storage_policy: Released baseline fixtures must cover all protected IDs and old in-flight tasks. Production snapshot remains a release gate. Reject ambiguous foreign plugin imports rather than automatic integer-only remapping.
legacy_policy: Retain built-in task adaptors, protocol entry points and legacy pricing for unmigrated channels/tasks. Plugin submission and polling use explicit plugin binding/execution snapshots. No bulk conversion at startup.
